title: A write to a WordPress site's static front page is named the home page
steps: S1: replace words on the home page of a site whose front page record keeps a demo title.
S2: a site-wide replace whose page read does not say home: page_on_front with show_on_front page, then show_on_front posts.
S3: the conversation memory asked about the front page id, other ids and other kinds.
S4: a write target marked front reaches the turn card's target and the Site changes description.
expect: S1: the receipt says "the home page, its content", never the demo title, and the caller is told post 42.
S2: post 42 is the front page only while show_on_front is page.
S3: only a WordPress post or page of that id is the front page, in that conversation.
S4: targetOf keeps front:true; describeEffects gives resource.op with front:true; nothing is marked without it.
evidence: Issue #257: a home page hero edit was named "Read the latest News + Blog" in the card and Site changes

tests: a write to the static front page is named the home page, whatever title its record keeps (#257)
isFront: a WordPress post or page of the front page id this conversation found, and nothing else (#257)
a front page mark reaches the turn card and Site changes beside the title, and only when set (#257)
